sources.title: HIBBS LAB
headings: We are investigating the fine details of fast communication in the nervous system, how this signaling goes awry in disease, and how drugs alter it. Ongoing projects span basic biophysics and structural biology to neuropharmacology, mechanisms underlying autoimmune diseases of the nervous system, and the evolution of neurotransmitter receptors.
sources.text: Welcome to the Hibbs Lab We are investigating the fine details of fast communication in the nervous system, how this signaling goes awry in disease, and how drugs alter it.
